verdict: Leads surged this week; cost per lead hit its best point yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 101 leads at an average cost of $18.06 per lead, with the most recent 7-day window delivering an 87.5% jump in leads versus the prior 7 days and a 46.93% drop in cost per lead. That efficiency gain is being driven by a single Meta campaign, which means the results are real but concentrated — a risk we're actively managing by monitoring for early signs of audience fatigue that appeared in the last three days of the window. On the local search side, your Weston location's Google Business Profile is generating a call rate of just 1.49% against 1,209 impressions this period, well below your other locations, and profile improvements are underway to bring it in line. Pipeline visibility is temporarily limited while a credential issue with the intake system is being resolved, so confirmed appointments may be under-reported this week.
